limits: Both map banks have been exposed; this is a reproducibility comparison, not a new blind or OOD test.
Baseline implementations are local reproductions/adaptations, not original-author published values.
A* is a deterministic geometric reference, once per map; its representation and expansion budget differ.
Equal NFE does not imply equal runtime or primitive operation counts; risk terms and planning time are reported.
Empirical external pass rate is not a finite-sample confidence certificate.
E0 has no uncertainty bank and no terminal polish; E5 retains nominal terminal polish.
Main remains exactly soft_beta050; only matched controls are repaired.
Native baseline proposal/adaptation mechanics are retained. Outside-gate scalarization differs from DE lexicographic selection; E3 compares global-search packages, not a single mutation rule.
E5 removes the risk-dependent soft term by definition and retains nominal terminal polish.
E6 includes the interaction of a discrete estimator with unchanged finite-difference polish; fixed-path variance is tested separately in P0.
Some results are inherited from the recorded source run. Cross-session runtime is descriptive, not an efficiency superiority test.

statistical_analysis.interpretation: Exploratory known-map comparison; nonsignificance is not equivalence.
